book.name: 2 Timoseo
book.title: Ɨnyarʉbha ya kabhɨrɨ ya Paaurʉ kwa Timoseo

content: Nɨrakʉtʉma embere wa Mungu na mʉbhʉtangɨ bhwa Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ, wʉnʉ akʉtɨnɨra abhahʉru na abhaku, na newe araazɨ kʉkangata nchʉ ʉmʉtɨmi.
Nangʉ, rwaza ɨngʼana ya Mungu. Okorebhu ribhaga ryʉryʉsi, rizʉmu hamwɨ riibhɨ. Recha na yangirija, ʉbhahɨ umwʉyʉ na kubhiija kubhwigumirirya bhwʉsi.
Rɨraaza ribhaga rɨnʉ abhaatʉ bhakʉbha bhatakwitegeerera amiija ga amaheene. Bharabha bhareenda kwitegeerera ganʉ gakʉbhazomerabhu, na korobhora abhiija bhaaru bhu ukubhiija ganʉ bhakʉsɨɨga kwigwa.
Bharatiga kwitegeerera amaheene, na bharatuna amaganʉ gɨ ɨkarɨ ganʉ gataana enzobhooro yʉyʉʉsi.
Nawe awɨ, ʉbhɨ mɨɨsʉ kwa gʉʉsi, wiigumiriryɨ ɨnyaakʉ, okore emeremo ju ukurwaza Ɨngʼana Ɨnzʉmu, okore bhwaheene mobhohocha bhwazʉ bhwʉsi.
Nɨrakʉbhʉʉrɨra gayo, kʉ kʉbha amasaahɨ gaanɨ garɨ haguhɨ kuhurukibhwa nchi ikimweso, ahagero hu ukuhurukirya ikimweso.
Ribhaga ryanɨ ryu ukukwa rihikirɨ haguhɨ.
Nitɨɨnɨ riihɨ rizʉmu, nɨmarirɨ orogendo, na nigwatirɨ ubhwisirirya.
Nangʉ ɨsaagirɨ kʉhaabhwa ɨkɨrʉngʉ che eheene. Ʉmʉkʉrʉ Yɨɨsu, umutiniri we eheene, arangʼa urusikʉ rwʉ ʉkʉgarʉka kwazɨ. Ɨtarɨ inyɨ inyimwene, nawe na abhandɨ bhʉʉsi bhanʉ bhakwisega kʉgarʉka kwawe.
Amasabhi ga Paaurʉ kwa Timoseo
Timoseo, ikongʼeererya kuuza bhwangʉ ɨwaanɨ,
kʉ kʉbha Deema antigirɨ. Ewe akasɨɨga amangʼana ga kʉʉsɨ, akatɨnɨra kuja kʉrʉbhɨri rwa Tɨsarʉʉnikɨ. Kirɨsikɨ agiirɨ icharʉ cha Garaatiya, na Tiitʉ agiirɨ icharʉ cha Darimatiya.
Ruuka umwene newe asaagirɨ hamwɨmwɨ na niinyɨ hanʉ. Nangʉ, uriizɨ ɨnʉ, uuzɨ na Maaroko, kʉ kʉbha aratʉra kʉnsakirya emeremo ja Mungu.
Nɨkatʉma Tikikʉ ʉrʉbhɨri rwa Efeeso.
Hanʉ ʉraazɨ, uuzɨ nɨ ɨkabhuuti yaanɨ yɨnʉ natigirɨ kwa Karipʉ, ʉrʉbhɨri rwa Turowa, nɨ ɨbhɨtabhʉ bhirya, kɨnda bhya riseero.
Arɨkizanda umuturi wi ibhyʉma, ankʉrɨɨrɨ ʉbhʉbhɨ bhʉkʉngʼu. Ʉmʉkʉrʉ aramʉtɨnɨra kʉrɨngʼaana na amahocha gaazɨ.
Na naawɨ wiyangarɨrɨ nawe, kʉ kʉbha aarɨ araanga bhʉkʉngʼu amiija gɨɨtʉ.
Hanʉ niibhagiirɨ mʉtɨnɨrʉ korogendo rwe embere, ataarɨ areho nʉʉrʉ wʉmwɨ wʉnʉ imiiriirɨ ʉrʉbhaara rwanɨ, bhʉʉsi bhakantiga. Nɨrasabha Mungu atigɨ kʉbhabharɨra ʉbhʉsarya bhuyo.

Nawe Ʉmʉkʉrʉ aarɨ hamwɨmwɨ na niinyɨ, akangʼa amanaga kwerekeererya Ɨngʼana Ɨnzʉmu yʉʉsi, korereke abhaatʉ bhʉʉsi bhanʉ bhatarɨ Abhayaahudi bhiigwɨ. Akansabhʉra muruku, kʉ kʉbha naarɨ nkina mumunywa gwɨ ɨɨka.
Nɨɨzɨ arangʼeha kʉnsabhʉra mʉmabhɨ gʉʉsi, na kundiibha kuhika mʉbhʉtɨmi bhwazɨ bhwa mwisaarʉ. Ʉmʉkʉrʉ agungibhwɨ kemerano! Garamɨ.
Amangʼana gʉ ʉkʉraga
Okeerye Akiira nʉ ʉmʉkari waazɨ Pirisiira, na bhanʉ bhari munyumba ya Ʉnɨsifʉrʉ.
Ɨraasitʉ akasaaga mʉrʉbhɨri rwa Kʉrintʉ. Tʉrʉfimʉ nɨkamutiga kʉrʉbhɨri rwa Mireeto, aarɨ murwɨrɨ.
Nangʉ, okore bhwangʉ kuuza ribhaga rye embeho rɨkɨɨrɨ kuhika. Ɨbhuurʉ, Pudɨ, Riinʉ, na Kiraudiya, hamwɨmwɨ na abhiisirirya bhʉʉsi, bharakokeerya.
Ʉmʉkʉrʉ abhɨ hamwɨmwɨ na naawɨ. Ɨbhɨgʉngi bhyazɨ bhɨbhɨ hamwɨmwɨ na niimwɨ.
